stage_first_commission.intro: A quiet commission sends Rocco and Sprocket into the museum. Five paintings should be a simple job. The delivery list may say otherwise.

recaps.first_commission: The order includes Sprocket's device. Rocco refuses the delivery and keeps the paintings at the Safehouse, where Tuck helps build a gallery.
recaps.false_owners: The first hidden fragment reveals records left by Barnaby Bramble. Four more fragments remain. Rocco and Sprocket follow the trail toward Paris.

stage_hidden_routes.intro: The first fragment raises questions about the paintings' past. In Paris, Rocco and Sprocket look for the marks that an altered label cannot hide.

recaps.lower_threshold: A copied maker's mark points to Atlas workshops. Quill joins the investigation and traces Atlas shipments through Istanbul depots.
recaps.harbor_collection: Atlas moves artworks under false names. The crew stops following the Curator's orders and begins its own investigation, following a shipment with a wrong address.

stage_sealed_shipment.intro: A wrong address is the next lead. Rocco's growing gallery is also a trail of evidence, and Quill wants to know where that trail really leads.

recaps.wrong_address: A false label conceals the route to a harbor archive. Inside waits a sealed shipment that could connect the scattered records.
recaps.sealed_shipment: The second fragment maps the transfer network. Glimmer funds its links. Quill insists that proof needs people as well as files.

stage_silent_auction.intro: Glimmer's silent auction offers a way into the network. Rocco needs more than a stolen invitation: the crew needs a connection it can verify.

recaps.silent_auction: An old signature links the Curator to Atlas. Quill seeks an unsigned letter in a designer's storage to test the connection.
recaps.unsigned_letter: Quill verifies the Curator's place in Atlas's history. Rocco stops taking his calls. Two collections claiming the same painting become the next lead.

stage_double_entry.intro: Two collections claim one painting. The crew follows the conflicting records into the restoration archive, searching for the history behind the labels.

recaps.two_collections: One ownership record has been assigned to two paintings. The restoration archive holds the original records that may expose the substitution.
recaps.double_entry: The Curator reveals himself as Mr. Frost and proposes keeping everything under his control. The third fragment names living families. Quill wants to find them.

stage_missing_voices.intro: The records now point to living families. Rocco and Quill follow those names, asking what a recovered history means to the people who remember it.

recaps.missing_voices: A recovered chest brings a name home. Rocco begins to value more than the payday and agrees to open the Safehouse gallery for a public showing.
recaps.open_door: The showing makes headlines. Glimmer responds with a polite invitation to Atlas. Rocco recognizes the threat behind his manners.

stage_behind_the_labels.intro: The gallery is no longer a secret. With Glimmer paying attention, Rocco and Quill must defend the story behind the collection as carefully as the works themselves.

recaps.polite_threat: Glimmer attacks Rocco through the press. Quill finds that a publisher changed witness testimony, and the crew follows the source.
recaps.whose_story: The testimony was rewritten for Glimmer. Quill and Rocco prepare to publish the original while another fragment waits inside a closed exhibition.

stage_cost_of_trust.intro: Pressure builds around the next fragment. Recovering the record is only part of the job: the crew must decide whom it can trust to protect it.

recaps.pressure_after_dark: The fourth fragment names those who profited. Mr. Frost offers protection, but Quill proposes shared custody instead of a single keeper.
recaps.cost_of_trust: Researchers and communities offer an alternative to Mr. Frost's control. Atlas begins moving its archive and destroying pages along the way.

stage_last_offer.intro: Atlas is moving the archive and destroying pages. Rocco and his partners race to preserve what remains before the record disappears.

recaps.missing_page: Quill uncovers Glimmer's destruction order. Glimmer offers to buy the crew's silence and demands a meeting in person.
recaps.last_offer: Rocco rejects Glimmer's offer. A lead in Barnaby's work points toward the device's origin and Glimmer's last private showcase.

stage_whose_museum.intro: One private showcase stands between the crew and the complete archive. Barnaby's work may explain the device, but the future of the record is still undecided.

recaps.final_inventory: Sprocket verifies that Barnaby designed the device's heart. Rocco rejects Mr. Frost's demand and turns toward Glimmer's principal collection and the last fragment.
recaps.whose_museum: The archive is complete. Rocco's decision determines who holds the record and what the world gets to learn.
